_comment: Copy to config.json and edit own_repos for your project(s). Everything else here is usable as-is: search_queries/topics/hn_queries/artefact_queries are generic 'agent architecture discovery' terms, not project-specific, so a fresh checkout can scan immediately. Nothing here posts, comments, or contacts anyone - scan only discovers, scores, and ranks; a human decides what (if anything) to write about, entirely outside this tool. Read README.md's Etiquette section before writing a teardown from anything this surfaces.
hn_queries: how I built my ai agent

publish_venues.name: Hacker News
publish_venues.etiquette: Regular submission, never Show HN. Show HN is for the poster's own project, so a teardown of someone else's work goes in as a normal link submission. Keep the title neutral and factual, no editorializing.

publish_venues.name: r/LocalLLaMA
publish_venues.etiquette: Check the subreddit's self-promotion rule before posting. Prefer a text post that summarizes the findings with the link included, not a bare link drop. Shadowban removals are invisible, so verify the post is visible while logged out.
